newsitem.title: USA: US spot products stay firm in mild afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot products stay firm in mild afternoon trade.

text.p: U.S. spot products prices stayed firm in afternoon dealings, tracking gains on NYMEX amid featureless dealings, industry sources said.
Gasolines led the gains, with most grades jumping by about 1.50 cents a gallon from Thursday. Heating oil and other distillates climbed by about 0.75 cent.

The strength on gasoline was apparently a function of shrinking gasoline runs at the nations refineries and slimmer imports, traders said. Consolidation on NYMEX was also a factor contributing to the rise.

Differentials were generally stable at both centers. Traders said prompt gasoline diffs at the U.S. Gulf edged up somewhat on active buying by refiners. And in New York, winter grade oxygenated gasoline has begun to show to signs of life.

Distillate buyers were hard to find at both centers. Prompt two oil in New York stayed near even with November NYMEX. In London, diesel premiums rose amid continued perceptions of supply scarcity, while gasoline was weaker on talk that the transatlantic arb was shut.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
